# MH-24 — Identify overdue hikers

**Business value:** 928

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee
I want to be alerted when a hiker has not checked in by the expected time
So that I can assess the situation and initiate the appropriate safety procedure

## Notes

If a hiker does not record the end of the hike, after 2 hours from the expected return time is considered missing and the system sends a notification, and a new notification is sent after each following hour until 6 hours reached.
The notification is a pop-up on the app web page and an email to the warden.
